changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwPatient AS SELECT p.id, p.medical_record_number, p.first_name, p.second_name, p.third_name, p.last_name, p.sex_at_birth, p.date_of_birth, p.patient_classes, p.is_private_patient, p.first_name_secondary_lang, p.second_name_secondary_lang, p.third_name_secondary_lang, p.last_name_secondary_lang, p.primary_mobile_number, p.receive_sms, p.second_mobile_number, p.home_phone, p.work_phone, p.email, p.receive_email, p.preferred_way_of_contact, p.preferred_language, p.emergency_contact_name, p.emergency_contact_relation, p.emergency_contact_phone, p.role, p.marital_status, p.nationality, p.religion, p.ethnicity, p.occupation, p.responsible_party, p.educational_level, p.previous_id, p.archiving_number, p.details, p.is_unknown, p.is_verified, p.is_completed_patient, p.security_access_level, p.created_by, p.created_date, p.last_modified_by, p.last_modified_date, p.is_cchi_patient, p.document_id, p.patient_status, p.merged_into_patient_id, p.merged_at, p.merged_by, p.merge_note, p.blood_group, p.patient_conditions FROM public.patients p;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwPatient TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwPatient FROM report_user;
